title: Non-Myopic Safety Filtering with Learned Intervention Cost-to-Go
abstract: arXiv:2611.21036v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters minimize instantaneous deviation from a nominal control command, but a sequence of pointwise-minimal interventions need not minimize cumulative intervention effort. This paper proposes a discrete-time non-myopic safety filter using a learned approximation of the optimal intervention cost-to-go over CBF-admissible policies. The approximation enters through a relaxed Bellman-residual constraint, while the original barrier condition remains hard. Feasibility is equivalent to that of the conventional CBF filter, and forward invariance remains independent of approximation accuracy under the stated assumptions. We derive a trajectory-wise performance certificate that requires neither the optimal value function nor an approximation-error bound. Under additional approximation and horizon assumptions, a suboptimality bound contains an explicit endpoint approximation-error term together with accumula

translated_title: 基于学习干预剩余代价的非短视安全滤波
translated_abstract: 控制屏障函数（CBF）安全滤波器最小化与名义控制指令的瞬时偏差，但一系列逐点最小化的干预未必能最小化累积干预努力。本文提出了一种离散时间的非短视安全滤波器，它使用在CBF可行策略上对最优干预剩余代价的学习近似。该近似通过一个松弛的贝尔曼残差约束引入，而原始的屏障条件仍保持为硬约束。该滤波器的可行性与传统CBF滤波器等价，并且在所述假设下，前向不变性仍然独立于近似精度。我们推导了一个轨迹级的性能证书，该证书既不需要最优值函数，也不需要近似误差界。在额外的近似和时域假设下，次优性界中包含一个显式的端点近似误差项以及累积（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种用学习到的最优干预剩余代价近似实现的非短视CBF安全滤波器，在保持与传统CBF滤波器相同可行性和前向不变性的前提下减少累积干预努力，并给出无需最优值函数或近似误差界的轨迹级性能证书。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a non-myopic CBF safety filter that uses a learned approximation of the optimal intervention cost-to-go to reduce cumulative intervention effort while preserving feasibility and forward invariance, and provides a trajectory-wise performance certificate requiring neither the optimal value function nor approximation-error bounds.
